A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FedMUD study. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching v1's Appendix C proof to v2's Appendix D.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A report original accuracy, convergence and ablation experiments, including ResNet18 evaluations on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A retain the original empirical evaluations, including benchmark comparisons, sensitivity analyses and ResNet18 results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same MUD, BKD and AAD procedures, initialization rules, resetting and aggregation. The added discussion of non-zero initialization concerns cited research, not a change to FedMUD.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate FMNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, plus TinyImageNet in Appendix A. The corresponding IID and non-IID scenarios are unchanged; the newly discussed research fields are not evaluated.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain FedAvg, FedHM, FedLMT, FedPara, EF21-P and FedBAT, with the same restricted comparator set in the ResNet18 experiment. BoRA is newly discussed but not evaluated; citation-year suffix changes do not identify new baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix A retain the same partitions, architectures, client sampling, local epochs, batch size, training budgets, compression settings and hyperparameter searches. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The freezing-versus-decoupling comparisons and analyses of reset intervals, initialization values and compression ratios are unchanged in Sections 5.3–5.6 and Appendix A. The new Appendix C contains contextual discussion rather than an additional analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions state that each experiment is run five times and averages are reported. Tables 1 and 3 retain the same plus-minus reporting; no additional run counts, uncertainty procedures or statistical tests are introduced.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and Figures 2–7 retain their results and trends. For example, FedMUD+BKD+AAD remains at 41.2 ± 0.5 on CIFAR-100 Non-IID-1 in Table 1, and 33.4 on TinyImageNet with ResNet18 at 32-fold compression in Table 5.

T1.justification: The assumptions, Theorem 1, lemmas, derivations and BKD rank discussion are unchanged. The complete convergence proof is renumbered from Appendix C to Appendix D, with corresponding cross-reference updates.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same three contributions and claims concerning convergence, accuracy and communication efficiency. The added literature discussion does not revise their scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations of aggregation errors, reset-interval effects and initialization sensitivity remain unchanged. New Appendix C suggests interpretable communication compression as future research, but supplies no substantive new result interpretation, mechanism explanation or limitation.

D1.justification: The architecture descriptions, optimization and initialization settings, communication procedures and code-access information are unchanged. The new related-work citations do not disclose additional implementation or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 6.1 adds discussion of BoRA's similar block-wise mechanism and research on non-zero LoRA initialization. New Appendix C adds references connecting the work to model compression, interpretability and causal reasoning. These broaden context without substantially redefining the contribution.

P1.justification: v2 adds two sentences to Section 6.1 and a short appendix titled 'Connection to More Fields.' The proof appendix and cross-references are renumbered, while the main narrative and existing explanations remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The added discussion and references reflow the bibliography and appendix pages, changing proof page breaks and the placement of existing appendix material. Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–6 retain their designs and content.

improvement.justification: Section 6.1 now acknowledges closely related block-wise LoRA and initialization research, modestly improving the completeness of the research context. Appendix C's broad future direction adds little evidential value. With methods, experiments, proofs and reproducibility unchanged, the overall quality gain is limited.
